items.name: auth-forms
items.title: Auth Forms
items.description: Password sign-in, sign-up, reset-request and reset forms. Use them on authentication pages. Presentational: wire onSubmit to the headless actions of @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/client/actions, as the templates' client/pages/auth/ pages do.
items.docs: Presentational: each form calls onSubmit(values) and renders what it is given (submitting, error, fieldErrors, labels with English defaults). Wire onSubmit to @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/client/actions (the templates' client/pages/auth/ pages are the reference), pass translated labels, and put links in forgotPasswordLink and footer.

items.name: auth-methods
items.title: Auth Methods
items.description: Switches between several sign-in methods in tabs and lists single sign-on providers below them. Use it on a sign-in page offering more than a password. Presentational: each method's content is a form you wire, such as auth-forms over @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication.
items.docs: Pass methods as {id, label, content}; tabs appear only with more than one. Pass providers as {id, label, icon, onClick or href}; from three providers on they become icon buttons. Labels have English defaults; pass translated ones.

items.name: auth-centered-layout
items.title: Auth Centered Layout
items.description: The page around an authentication form: the brand above a card in the middle of a muted page. Use it for sign-in, sign-up, password and device pages without a brand panel; the templates use auth-split-layout instead.
items.docs: Render AuthCenteredLayout as the whole page of a sign-in, sign-up or password route, with the form as its children.

items.name: auth-split-layout
items.title: Auth Split Layout
items.description: The page around an authentication form: the form on the left and the application's own content on the right of a wide screen. Use it for sign-in, sign-up and password pages; the templates' client/pages/auth/shared.tsx renders it.
items.docs: Render AuthSplitLayout as the whole page of a sign-in, sign-up or password route, with the form as its children and the application's own content in aside, shown from the xl breakpoint up.

items.name: device-approval
items.title: Device Approval
items.description: The /device page where a signed-in person approves or denies the sign-in of a CLI or another device (RFC 8628 device authorization). Use it when a CLI signs in through the browser. Wired: calls Better Auth's device endpoints through useAuthentication() from @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/client.
items.docs: Needs wiring before it works: enable deviceAuthorization() and bearer() in server/config/auth.ts, add an application migration creating Better Auth's deviceCode table, and register deviceAuthorizationClient() in client/config/auth.ts. Render DeviceApproval on a /device route only signed-in people reach (auth: 'optional', sending others to /login?redirect=), passing ?user_code= as userCode, and spread locales/ into client/locales/. The authentication plugin's Skill (references/better-auth-plugins.md) has the details.
